subject: accessible fallback and responsive layout
outcome: The canvas has an accessible label and focus target; text search and selectable buttons offer non-pointer anatomy access, the interface stacks for compact screens, and no mandatory animated environment runs.
acceptanceCriteriaReviewed: Test keyboard focus, non-pointer fallback, explanatory text and responsive layout
Ensure motion and optional effects honor accessibility preferences
validation: Architecture unit checks and rendered Chromium desktop/mobile review; relevant scene behavior inspected in source and QA captures.
limits: No claim of full formal WCAG conformance without dedicated assistive-technology assessment.

review.note: Deliverable is implemented in independently authored project code and checked against recorded public evidence and browser tests.
